description: Rettungskette in Sachsen - Hubschrauberlandeplätze bei Rettungseinsätzen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoh.conterra. The dataset contains the heliports for the rescue service in the Saxon forest. Helicopter landing sites are rescue points/collection points for foresters and emergency personnel during a fire and to coordinate rescue operations in the event of accidents in the context of forest work, where a helicopter landing option is also available. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Rescue chain in Saxony - heliports during rescue operations" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Waldbrandschutzkarte, Rettungswagentreffpunkt, Rettungspunkte, Rettungskette, Einsatzpersonal, Rettungsfahrezeuge. The listing shows 2019-03-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
